BiblicalUsage: Chabat means to beat out, to thresh. The law said to beat the olive tree once and leave the rest for the stranger, Gideon was beating out wheat in a winepress when the angel found him, Ruth beat out the barley she had gleaned, and God promises He will beat off His people one by one and gather them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe threshing is how God separates what feeds from what does not. Gideon threshed in hiding and became a judge, Ruth threshed what she gleaned and became an ancestor of kings.
RelatedEvents: Gideon's Victory over Midian; Ruth's Loyalty
